title: Wed 25 Nov · evening check
summary:
[b]Today:[/b] US Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% and core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2% (USD R3 shadow +2, score held at +7); USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies incl. the EU, Japan and Switzerland (Canada spared); BoE's Mann wants hikes 'more and sooner'; RBA silent after the hot CPI; Nasdaq −2% to −4%, VIX ~30 intraday. No published score changes; 6 pairs under pressure, 10 under watch.
[b]Next:[/b] Thu 26 Nov US Thanksgiving, French CMP (time n/v), ECB accounts 14:30; Fri 27 Nov Tokyo CPI, France GDP 09:45, NZ election result, US half-day.

USD.note: Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% (cons 3.5%), core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2%: R3 +2 (raw 7.65, held at +7); December hike priced in the mid-to-high 90s.

EUR.note: EU named in the US Section 301 tariff proposal (15% deal cap); N2 already −1; French CMP on Thursday.

GBP.note: Mann: hike "more and sooner"; Lombardelli hawkish, Dhingra dovish; ~81% priced (unverified); shadow +3 if R2 +1.

JPY.note: Monday's risk-on condition reversed; Japan on the US tariff list (15% cap): shadow −3 if N2 +1 → 0; no MoF comment.

CHF.note: Haven winner; VIX ~30–33 intraday (no close above 30 yet); Switzerland on the US tariff list: shadow −1 if N2 −1.

CAD.note: Canada not on the US tariff list; Brent ~$90–91; BoC pricing reports conflict (unverified).

AUD.note: CPI data half met, RBA silent; Dec hold 96.7%, May cut odds 48% from 56%; deeper risk-off also met the weakening line.

NZD.note: Carried: Q3 retail beat; risk-off met the NZDCAD weakening line intraday; election result Friday.

XAU.note: Gold −1.4% to −2.4% after PCE (price only); 10-year −6bp; XAUUSD dollar condition half met.
